name: failed prev-day-low break long
note: Breakdown sellers and stop-entry shorts under yesterday's low are trapped when price reclaims it; their covering and stop buys fuel the reversal.

name: sweep high bear engulf short
note: Breakout longs entered on a swept high are trapped by a bearish engulfing reversal; their stops sit just below and get hit as price falls.

name: downtrend supertrend flip short
note: Trailing-stop longs in a downtrend are forced out when the trailing stop flips; their exits and trend sellers add supply with no dip buyers above.

name: failed rally under EMA100 short
note: Dip-buyers who bought a rally that failed to reclaim the falling EMA are left holding; as momentum rolls over they sell into weak bids.

name: Asia range breakout long with volume
note: Asia-session range sellers and fade traders sit with stops just above the range; a volume-backed break forces them to cover, and quiet-range compression gives room to run.

name: Asia range breakdown short with volume
note: Range buyers with stops below the Asia low are forced out on a volume-backed break; compression means sellers meet thin bids and price travels.

name: bearish FVG retest short
note: Buyers who chase into an unfilled bearish gap meet resting supply left by the impulsive selling; trapped late longs sell at breakeven and add pressure.

name: WaveTrend oversold turn long
note: Panic sellers at extreme oversold levels exhaust their supply; as the oscillator turns, shorts cover into thin offers and price snaps back.

name: bearish divergence above VWAP short
note: Late buyers pay a premium over average traded price while momentum fades on a higher high; their weak conviction yields to profit-taking.

name: overbought HTF with 1h EMA break short
note: Longs who bought an overbought higher-timeframe move have no cushion; a loss of the short EMA triggers stop-outs that cascade into the fade.

name: oversold HTF with EMA reclaim long
note: Shorts who sold an oversold higher-timeframe flush have no cushion; a reclaim of the short EMA triggers covering that feeds the bounce.

name: below cloud momentum turn short
note: Holders under the Ichimoku cloud are underwater with overhead supply; each momentum turn down prompts sellers to exit, with no support from cloud buyers.

name: high-volume bearish marubozu short
note: A large bearish bar on heavy volume indicates forced liquidation; longs underwater exit gradually and stops cascade for follow-through.

name: high-volume bull bar below EMA100 long
note: A volume-backed bull bar from below a long average signals short covering by trapped sellers; stop buys follow while few new sellers appear.

name: Keltner breakdown short in trend
note: A close below the lower Keltner band with directional pressure forces breakout stops and trend-chasing sellers; dip-buyers are overwhelmed in established downtrends.

name: oversold stoch cross above HTF low long
note: Sellers pushing price into oversold territory while it holds above the 4h low are exhausted; weak hands exit as support holds and shorts cover.

name: squeeze release downside short
note: After volatility compression, range traders positioned for continued quiet are caught on the wrong side; downside release below both EMAs triggers stops and short momentum entries.

name: Keltner blowoff fade
note: Late chasers buying an extreme extension in a non-trending market have no follow-through buyers; the move reverts as liquidity provision returns.

name: HTF overbought divergence short
note: Momentum buyers on a stretched 4h chart keep buying a higher high on weaker momentum; the marginal buyer is exhausted and late longs must exit.

name: Asia range breakdown short
note: Asian-session range lows hold stop orders of range traders; when London volume breaks them, stops cascade and shorts get follow-through.

name: Supertrend short with HTF filter
note: Trailing-stop holders of longs are forced out on the flip, and the 4h downtrend means rallies get sold by hedgers rather than bought.

name: WaveTrend oversold turn long
note: In ranging markets forced sellers overshoot and exhaust; when selling momentum turns, shorts who sold the low must cover into the bounce.

name: WaveTrend overbought turn short
note: Overextended buyers in a range lose momentum; late longs holding at the top must sell as the bid thins.

name: Ichimoku below cloud short
note: Price under the cloud with a tenkan/kijun cross means trapped longs from the cloud region are underwater and sell every bounce.

name: Inside bar upside break
note: Compression bars pile stop orders above the bar; the break forces short stops to buy and attracts momentum entries.

name: Inside bar downside break
note: Compression bars pile stop orders below the bar; the break forces long stops to sell and attracts momentum shorts.

name: Sweep low reclaim long
note: Breakdown sellers who hit stops below the low are trapped when a strong bull bar reclaims the level; they must cover.

name: Sweep high rejection short
note: Breakout buyers above the high are trapped when a strong bear bar closes back under the level; they must sell.

name: VWAP loss short
note: Participants who bought above the volume-weighted average are underwater when price loses it; they sell into rallies back to breakeven.

name: CCI oversold recovery long
note: Panic sellers in a range overshoot below VWAP; once momentum recovers, shorts covering and value buyers drive a reversion.

name: Trend onset short
note: When a ranging market starts trending down, range-fading longs get run over and must cover losses, feeding the move.

name: prev-day-low breakdown
note: Longs who bought above yesterday's low have stops clustered just under it; a break on volume triggers forced sell-stops and adds momentum sellers, who cannot avoid it because their exits are mechanical.

name: failed high sweep
note: Breakout buyers entering above the 20-bar high get trapped when the sweep fails and the bar closes bearish; their stop-outs and late-chasing longs provide supply into the reversal.

name: bearish RSI divergence
note: A higher high on weaker momentum means marginal buyers are exhausted; late longs holding the new high lack follow-through and are the exit liquidity for informed sellers.

name: supertrend flip down
note: Trailing-stop longs get ejected when the ATR trail breaks; their forced selling plus trend followers flipping short creates a cascade, symmetrical to the long trend rules but earning on falling markets.

name: HTF overbought pullback
note: When the 4h is stretched, a loss of the 1h EMA20 signals dip buyers failing; holders from the extended leg have large unrealised profit and sell into the first weakness.

name: bearish engulf at highs
note: A bar that fully engulfs the previous one after an overbought push shows aggressive sellers absorbing all prior buying; buyers from the prior bar are underwater immediately and exit into the move.

name: low sweep reversal
note: Breakdown sellers who sold the 20-bar low are trapped when a bullish engulfing bar reclaims the level; their buy-to-cover stops fuel the reversal.

name: Keltner reclaim bounce
note: After a volatility-driven flush below the Keltner band, forced liquidations are exhausted; the close back inside marks the end of stop-driven selling and shorts take profit.

name: ichimoku tenkan-kijun down below cloud
note: Price under the cloud with short-term line crossing down marks sustained supply; longs bought into the cloud are underwater and use rallies to exit.

name: MACD cross down above zero
note: Momentum rolling over after an uptrend while RSI no longer supports it; trend buyers who added late hold losing positions and reduce into the loss of impulse.

name: VWAP loss
note: Volume-weighted average is the cost basis of recent participants; once price falls through, the average buyer is underwater and many benchmark-driven buyers stop supporting price.

name: FVG retest rejection
note: Unfilled bearish gap reflects unfilled sell orders; the retest into it meets resting sellers, while buyers who bid the bounce are caught as price is rejected.

name: spike up fade
note: A volatility spike up in a non-trending market is often stop-run or panic buying; spike buyers are momentum chasers with no information, and price reverts once liquidity returns.

name: squeeze release down
note: After volatility compression ends with price below a falling EMA, stored energy releases down; range traders positioned for continuation of quiet get stopped and sellers add.

name: bull divergence in range under VWAP
note: A lower low with higher RSI in a range signals seller exhaustion below VWAP; late shorts have little downside left, and price reverts to the average where their covering supports the move.

name: Donchian breakdown trend
note: A new 20-bar low in an established downtrend triggers sell stops from earlier breakout longs and attracts trend-following systems that must follow the signal mechanically.

name: range extreme overextension short
note: In a non-trending regime, an extreme-band spike is chased by late momentum buyers with no follow-through; liquidity providers fade it and price reverts to the mean.

name: bear divergence above vwap
note: New high on weaker momentum means buying is exhausted; longs holding above VWAP are at a profit with no new buyers, and they exit into thin demand.

name: sweep low reclaim long
note: Stop runs below the n-bar low trap breakdown sellers; once the stops are filled the supply is gone, and trapped shorts must buy back on the engulfing reclaim.

name: downtrend supertrend flip short
note: Trend-following funds and trailing-stop holders are forced to sell when the ATR trail flips below a falling higher-timeframe average, adding persistent supply.

name: htf overbought roll-over short
note: When the 4h RSI is stretched and 1h price loses its short EMA, dip-buyers are underwater and their exits arrive as the first support fails.

name: htf oversold turn long
note: After a stretched 4h decline, panic sellers are exhausted and shorts take profit as price reclaims the fast EMA; short-covering and mean reversion give the room.

name: early range break with trend short
note: Range-low break aligned with a falling EMA catches the side already losing; counter-trend range buyers capitulate through their stops.

name: failed rally below htf trend short
note: Inside a higher-timeframe downtrend, losing VWAP means rally buyers are underwater and become sellers at their break-even point.

name: failed breakdown reclaim long
note: Price that broke below yesterday's low and then reclaims it traps breakdown shorts, who must buy back to cut losses.

name: failed breakout prev high short
note: Breakout buyers above yesterday's high are trapped when price falls back under it; their stops cluster just below and fuel the drop.

name: kijun loss below cloud short
note: Loss of the base line under the cloud edge forces systematic Ichimoku followers and trapped dip-buyers out as support converts to resistance.

name: capitulation bar bounce long
note: A huge-volume full-body down bar outside the lower band is forced liquidation and margin selling; once the forced supply clears, price snaps back toward the mean.

name: momentum fade from strength short
note: Histogram turning negative while RSI is still elevated marks the first loss of upside momentum; late longs have no cushion and exit at once.

name: failed high sweep short
note: Breakout buyers and stop-buyers above the 20-bar high get trapped when the sweep fails; their forced exits plus stop-run sellers feed the drop.

name: asia range break down
note: Quiet Asian-session range holds resting stops below it; when London volume breaks the low, those stops and range-fade buyers become forced sellers.

name: london open range break short
note: Early London range buyers are trapped when price breaks the opening low below VWAP; their stops cluster just under the low.

name: bear engulf extended
note: An engulfing bar after an extended rally shows buyers absorbed and reversed in one bar; late longs hold underwater positions and sell into weakness.

name: kijun break below cloud
note: Loss of the base line while under the cloud forces mean-reverting dip buyers to capitulate, as the cloud now acts as overhead supply.

name: htf bearish rally fade
note: A rally inside a bearish 4h regime is counter-trend; counter-trend buyers are short-term and exit when the rally stalls, with the higher timeframe sellers returning.

name: stop hunt reversal long
note: Breakout shorts and sell stops fuel a wick below the 10-bar low; when it is fully reversed by an engulfing bar, those shorts are trapped and must cover.

name: squeeze release long
note: Volatility compression builds resting stops on both sides; when the squeeze ends, those stops and range traders caught short must cover into the expansion.

name: cci failed rally
note: A spike over +100 CCI on active volume that rolls back marks breakout buyers who had no follow-through and now defend nothing.

name: oversold below prev low long
note: In a non-trending tape, sell-stop breakers under yesterday's low are flushed to an oversold extreme; the sellers are done and liquidity providers revert price.

name: sweep high reject short
note: Breakout buyers and stop-buy orders fill above the recent high, then price falls back under the EMA. They are trapped with losses and their exit selling adds to the drop.

name: failed prev-day-high break
note: In a weak trend, breakout chasers buy the yesterday-high break and get rejected. Their stops sit just below, so their forced selling feeds the move down.

name: bear divergence at HTF strength
note: Momentum buyers push to a new high on weakening participation, so the last buyers are exhausted. Late longs hold at the top with no fresh buyers to take them out.

name: Asia range breakdown short
note: Asia-session range traders have stops just under the low and sellers at the break trigger them. Volume at the London open pushes through the quiet range and the stop orders add fuel.

name: London open range break long
note: Short sellers and range fade traders from the quiet pre-open are squeezed when the first London-hour high breaks on volume. Their buy-to-cover orders add to the move.

name: London open range break short
note: Longs who bought the quiet pre-open range are stopped out when the opening-hour low breaks on volume. Their sell stops sit clustered under the low.

name: squeeze end down
note: Dip buyers and range traders leaning on the compressed range are forced out when it resolves down. Stops cluster beneath the squeeze, so expansion pays the sellers.

name: downtrend rally exhaustion
note: Counter-trend buyers push to the top of the range inside a larger downtrend. When they stall, trend sellers resume and trapped dip buyers exit into weakness.

name: 4h low breakdown short
note: Buyers defending the last completed 4h low have stops beneath it. Once it breaks on volume, those forced exits turn the support level into supply.

name: Keltner spike rejection
note: Breakout chasers buy a spike beyond the volatility envelope and get a strong bearish close. They are stuck at the extreme with an immediate loss and their exits pressure price.

name: Keltner lower spike reversal long
note: Panic sellers and stop-runners push below the volatility envelope and the bar closes strongly up. The shorts that chased the extreme are offside and must cover.

name: stoch roll-over in weak HTF
note: In a weak higher timeframe, rallies are driven by short covering. When the stochastic rolls over the covering is done and the larger sellers return.

name: bearish FVG retest short
note: An impulsive drop leaves unfilled sell orders in the gap. A retest into it meets resting supply, and trapped buyers who bought the bounce sell into it.

name: Ichimoku bearish below cloud
note: Cloud-based buyers hold longs until price loses the base line. When price is below the cloud they have no structural support and must exit as it breaks.

name: sweep low reclaim long
note: Breakout sellers who sold the new low are trapped when price reclaims the EMA. Their buy-to-cover stops and absorbed liquidity fuel a bounce.

name: prev-day low break short
note: Buyers defending yesterday's low have stops beneath it. Once it breaks on volume their forced sells and short-side momentum entries compound the move.

name: failed high sweep short
note: Breakout buyers and stop-hunting longs enter above the prior 20-bar high; when price closes back under the EMA20 they are trapped and their stops and exits supply selling into the move.

name: overbought engulf short
note: Late momentum buyers chase an extended move; a bearish engulfing bar shows supply absorbed the whole prior bar, leaving them offside with stops just above.

name: supertrend flip short
note: Trend-following longs hold with trailing stops; the ATR trail breaking forces their exits while ADX confirms the move has directional energy, so the selling is mechanical rather than noise.

name: htf-weak pullback short
note: When the 4h trend is weak, rallies are bought by dip buyers who hold into resistance; the RSI losing 50 below VWAP shows the bounce failed and those buyers must exit into a declining market.

name: bearish divergence short
note: A higher high with weaker RSI means new buyers are thinner than the prior push; late breakout buyers are the marginal holders and get shaken out on the first reversal.

name: prev day low break short
note: Longs hold stops under yesterday's low as a known reference; a volume-confirmed break triggers those stop orders, creating forced market sells.

name: range top stoch rollover short
note: In low-ADX ranges breakouts above VWAP mostly fail; buyers who bought the top of the range are underwater when stochastic rolls over and supply returns to the mean.

name: band extreme exhaustion short
note: A close beyond 2.2 sigma with RSI above 72 is a liquidity-driven spike, often from stops and FOMO buyers; once the flow ends the move retraces to the mean.

name: wavetrend overbought cross short
note: Overbought WaveTrend rolling over marks buying pressure exhausting; momentum chasers holding at the extreme have no new buyers to sell to and exit together.

name: failed low sweep long
note: Breakdown sellers and short-stop hunters enter below the 20-bar low; reclaiming the EMA20 traps them, and their buy-to-cover orders push price up.

name: kc extreme engulf long
note: Panic sellers pushed price two ATR below the EMA; an engulfing bar shows absorption by buyers, leaving late shorts trapped at the lows.

name: kama break with momentum short
note: Adaptive MA only turns when efficiency is real; breaking it with negative MACD histogram shows trend followers flipping, forcing exits of the remaining longs.

name: extended HA run short
note: Five or more green HA candles with RSI above 70 means the move is crowded; trend traders are all long, so the next marginal flow is profit-taking.

name: 4h oversold turn long
note: When 4h RSI is washed out, forced sellers (liquidations, margin calls) are largely done; the 15m/1h RSI turning up marks their exhaustion and shorts become the crowded side.

name: CCI top rollover short
note: CCI falling back under 100 after an extreme above VWAP marks the point where breakout buyers lose their edge and become sellers; mean reversion to VWAP carries room.

name: below cloud tk cross short
note: Price under the Ichimoku cloud means holders from the prior range are underwater; a TK cross gives them a rule-based exit while supply from the cloud sits overhead.

name: squeeze release downside short
note: After a volatility squeeze, market makers and range traders are positioned for chop; when the squeeze ends with sellers dominant, they must reprice and hedge in the direction of the break.

name: failed rally in 4h downtrend
note: Dip buyers who bought the bounce inside a 4h downtrend are trapped when RSI rolls over; their stops and capitulation selling feed the continuation lower.

name: high sweep reversal short
note: Stops above the 20-bar high are harvested by a sweep; once price loses the EMA, longs who bought the break are underwater and forced to exit into thin bids.

name: exhausted spike fade
note: Late chasers buy extended moves in weak-trend conditions; with no fresh buyers left, price mean-reverts as profit takers outnumber new longs.

name: Keltner break in trend
note: In a trending market a break below the channel triggers stop-outs of dip buyers, and the cascade of forced sells continues the move.

name: bull divergence in downtrend
note: Late shorts press into a lower low on fading momentum; when selling is exhausted they must cover, giving a sharp short-covering bounce.

name: squeeze release long
note: Volatility compression leaves range traders with tight stops on both sides; when the squeeze ends, their stops fuel the directional expansion.

name: squeeze release short
note: After compression, range-bound longs with tight stops are flushed when the release breaks down, and stops feed the expansion.

name: kijun reclaim in downtrend
note: Shorts who sold under the base line are squeezed when price reclaims it on volume, and their buy-to-cover orders extend the bounce.

name: 4h weak momentum rollover
note: When higher-timeframe momentum is weak, intraday bounces to the midline attract trapped longs who sell on rejection, supplying continuation.

name: failed breakdown long
note: Breakdown sellers below yesterday's low in a ranging market get trapped by an engulfing reversal and must buy back, driving price back into the range.

name: failed breakout short
note: Breakout buyers above yesterday's high in a ranging market are trapped by a bearish engulfing bar; their stop exits push price back into the range.

name: bearish divergence short
note: New highs on fading momentum mean late buyers are absorbing distribution by larger holders; trapped longs have to exit when the higher high fails.

name: failed high sweep short
note: Breakout buyers who bought the sweep of the 20-bar high are trapped when price closes back under the EMA; their stops sit just below and fuel the drop.

name: extreme upper band fade
note: Extended moves beyond 2.5 sigma are driven by chasers and short covering that run out of fuel; they sell to liquidity providers who are happy to hold the reversion.

name: opening range break down
note: Range-bound participants with stops under the early session low are forced out on a volume-backed break, and breakout sellers pile in after a quiet range.

name: failed prev day high rejection
note: Breakout buyers above yesterday's high get engulfed immediately; their entries are underwater and they have to sell into the rejection.

name: htf overbought rollover short
note: When the 4h is overbought and the short-term momentum rolls over, dip buyers of the last leg are late and their entries get stopped as the 1h turns.

name: macd rollover from strength short
note: Momentum buyers entered during strength get squeezed out once MACD turns down from an elevated RSI; their exits add supply while no new buyers appear.

name: asia range break short
note: The quiet overnight range accumulates stops on both sides; a break lower as liquidity arrives forces out stale longs and invites momentum sellers.

name: heikin ashi exhaustion short
note: Five or more green candles with overbought RSI means late buyers have extended the move; the marginal buyer is exhausted and profit-takers become sellers.

name: htf oversold turn long
note: With the 4h oversold, forced sellers and panic stops are mostly spent; when short-term RSI turns up, shorts who sold the low get squeezed.

name: ema50 loss from strength short
note: A close back below the EMA50 while RSI is still elevated catches dip buyers who relied on the average as support; their stops sit just below and accelerate the move.

name: Bear engulf at upper band
note: Chasers who bought the band extension are caught by a full-body rejection candle; they hold underwater positions and have to sell into weakness as price reverts to the mean.

name: Below kijun with DI sellers
note: Positions bought above the kijun base line are underwater when price sits below it with seller dominance; margin and stop-driven liquidation of those holders extends the move.

name: WaveTrend overbought cross down
note: Momentum buyers at overbought extremes have no remaining buyers above them; when the oscillator turns, late longs are the marginal sellers and unwind into a thinning bid.

name: Keltner lower break in trend
note: A close outside the ATR channel in a trending market forces stop-outs of dip buyers, who sell into a vacuum rather than a bid.

name: Stoch rollover below VWAP
note: Buyers who bought a bounce into a falling market are below the volume-weighted average cost of the period; the rollover is their cue to exit, and they are net underwater sellers.

name: Failed prev day high break
note: Breakout buyers above yesterday's high are trapped when the bar closes back below it and below its open; their stops sit just below and accelerate the reversal.

name: Exhausted HA run fade
note: A run of green Heikin Ashi candles with overbought RSI in a non-strong trend means late buyers are paying the extreme; with no fresh demand, profit-takers set the next move.

name: Squeeze end up
note: Range-fade market makers are short volatility after a quiet compression; when the squeeze ends upward they must buy back hedges and cover, which expands the move.

name: Squeeze end down
note: Range sellers and sellers of volatility are caught when a compression resolves downward; their stops and hedges are bought-to-cover into falling prices... they must sell to hedge, expanding the move.

name: MACD roll-over in a downtrend
note: A bounce within a falling market recruits momentum buyers near the EMA50 resistance; when the histogram flips, those buyers are trapped above supply and sell to cut losses.

name: Rally sell below EMA100
note: Counter-trend rally buyers face trend sellers who defend the EMA100 area; once the stochastic turns, bounce buyers are trapped and trend sellers re-enter.

name: Dip buy in strong 4h momentum
note: Short-term sellers press a 15m/1h dip while 4h holders are not selling; once the CCI turns up, those late shorts are squeezed back toward the higher-timeframe level.

name: Quiet-range low break
note: After a low-ADX consolidation, long holders and limit buyers are stacked at the 20-bar low; a volume break takes the stops and leaves no bid below.

name: prev day low break short
note: Longs holding stops under yesterday's low are forced sellers once it breaks; volume confirms stop cascade and late buyers are trapped.

name: supertrend flip short
note: Trailing-stop holders of longs are forced out on the flip, and the exits add sell pressure to a move that has trend strength behind it.

name: pullback rejoin short in downtrend
note: In a falling EMA50 regime, rallies to the EMA20 are sold by trend holders adding positions; dip buyers get stopped on the cross.

name: overbought 4h rollover short
note: When the 4h RSI is stretched, momentum buyers are crowded; the first loss of the fast EMA triggers profit-taking from a one-sided position.

name: oversold 4h bounce long
note: Forced sellers and panic shorts are exhausted when 4h RSI is depressed; the first reclaim of the fast EMA triggers short covering.

name: macd cross short below ema200
note: In a long-term downtrend, bounces fade as trapped longs and trend sellers dominate each momentum rollover.

name: keltner break down in trend
note: A close outside the lower Keltner in a strong trend triggers breakout sellers and stop-outs of dip buyers whose invalidation sits just inside the band.

name: oversold divergence long
note: Sellers pushing a lower low on weaker momentum are exhausted; short sellers near the extreme cover into thin offers as the divergence confirms.

name: 4h low break short
note: Stops of longs sitting below the last completed 4h low trigger on a volume-backed break, producing forced selling into the move.

name: failed high sweep short
note: Breakout buyers and stop-buy orders above the recent high get trapped when the sweep fails and price closes back down; their forced exits plus stop-loss selling feed the move down.

name: extended rejection candle short
note: Buyers who chased an overextended move above the Keltner channel see a strong rejection candle; late longs are underwater immediately and sell into thin bids.

name: bear divergence below ema20
note: Higher highs on weakening momentum mean marginal buyers are exhausted; longs holding the second peak have no new demand and unwind once price slips under the short EMA.

name: htf overbought rollover short
note: Intraday dip-buyers lean on a stretched 4h move; when price loses the fast EMA the higher-timeframe longs are offside and must liquidate.

name: prev-day-low breakdown short
note: Longs with stops under yesterday's low are forced out when it breaks on volume, and breakout sellers add; stop orders cluster there so selling cascades.

name: london range break down
note: Traders fading the early-London range have stops just below its low; a volume break triggers them and adds to momentum while liquidity is deep.

name: vwap loss in red 4h bar
note: Participants anchored to the volume-weighted average cost are underwater when price loses vwap inside a down higher-timeframe bar; supply overhead caps rallies.

name: stop-hunt reclaim long
note: Short sellers entering on a low break are trapped when the sweep reverses; their covering and the stop-loss buying of breakdown shorts drives a squeeze.

name: oversold turn below vwap in chop
note: In directionless conditions, forced sellers who pushed price under rolling vwap run out of flow; price reverts to where most volume traded.

name: squeeze release downward
note: Range-sellers and buyers positioned for continued quiet are caught when volatility expands; stops cluster on both sides and the break direction gets fed by those exits.

name: downtrend momentum resume short
note: Counter-trend buyers who bought a bounce in a downtrend lose momentum as the histogram turns; they are trapped against trend sellers and exit into weakness.

name: exhausted green run fade
note: Six consecutive green candles with high RSI means chasers have bought into exhaustion; there is no remaining buyer to absorb profit-taking.

name: prev-day-high failure short
note: Breakout buyers above yesterday's high are trapped when price drops back below; their exits and fresh shorts add supply.

name: bullish gap retest long
note: A bullish imbalance leaves unfilled buy orders; shorts who sold the pullback into the gap are squeezed when the level holds.

name: cci exhaustion rollover short
note: Late momentum buyers at extreme CCI see the move lose steam; as the oscillator rolls over, their stops are hit and supply builds.

name: failed prev-day-high break short
note: Breakout buyers above yesterday's high get trapped when price falls back under it; their stops and forced exits feed the downside while momentum is already weakening.

name: failed prev-day-low break long
note: Breakdown sellers below yesterday's low are trapped when price reclaims the level; their buy-to-cover and stop orders add fuel to the upside.

name: swept high rejection short
note: Stop-hunt above the 20-bar high lures breakout longs; once price closes back under the EMA, those late longs are underwater and must sell into a ranging market.

name: supertrend flip short
note: Trailing-stop holders of long positions are forced out when the ATR trail breaks, creating sell flow on top of trend-followers entering short in a trending regime.

name: Asia range breakdown short
note: Overnight range sellers' counterparties get stopped under the Asia low at the European open; stops trigger and volume expansion continues the move out of a compressed range.

name: RSI overbought exit short
note: Late momentum buyers who bought the overextended push see RSI roll over; they hold losing positions near the high and exit into thin bids as the move exhausts.

name: RSI oversold recovery long
note: Panic sellers at the extreme are exhausted; shorts who chased the low have little room left and cover as RSI turns back up, giving a bounce with room to run.

name: band-stretch bearish engulf short
note: Buyers who chased a two-sigma extension get engulfed by a reversal bar; trapped longs must sell back toward the mean.

name: Keltner stretch bounce long
note: Forced sellers pushed price two ATR below the EMA in a weak-trend market; stochastic turning up shows selling pressure is spent and shorts cover into the reversion.

name: HTF oversold bounce long
note: On a 4h oversold backdrop, late shorts are chasing an exhausted move; intraday momentum turning up forces them to cover.

name: failed rally below VWAP short
note: Buyers who bid price above the mean and are now below VWAP are underwater on average; their exits meet momentum sellers at a loss-making level.

name: reclaim above VWAP long
note: Shorts who sold below the average price are underwater when price reclaims VWAP and the EMA together; their cover orders add to buying.

name: WaveTrend overbought cross short
note: Momentum chasers at extreme WaveTrend readings are crowded long; once the signal line crosses down, the crowd has no new buyers and unwinds.

name: sweep plus bearish divergence short
note: The liquidity sweep above the prior high traps breakout buyers while the lower RSI at the new high shows no real buying behind it; they exit into the reversal.

name: 4h low break volume short
note: Longs with stops under the prior 4h low are forced out; the break on elevated volume brings in momentum sellers and stop cascades.

name: 4h high break volume long from low-trend
note: Shorts with stops above the prior 4h high are forced to cover on a volume break out of a weak-trend regime, adding fuel to the breakout.

name: new day low below HTF EMA short
note: Buyers defending the day's low with stops just underneath are flushed when it breaks while higher-timeframe trend is down, so their forced selling adds to the move.

name: range upper band exhaustion short
note: In low-ADX ranges, late breakout buyers chase an overextended push and have no trend to support them; they get squeezed back to the mean when momentum buyers run out.

name: prev day low breakdown on volume
note: Longs holding below-the-fold support get stopped out when yesterday's low breaks on heavy volume, and stop orders cascade into more selling.

name: bearish engulf after strength
note: Buyers who entered into strength are underwater after a full-body reversal bar and sell to cut losses into a market with no fresh buyers.

name: bearish RSI divergence short
note: A higher high on weaker momentum means late buyers are absorbing distribution from informed sellers, and these buyers hold underwater positions.

name: vwap loss with weak higher timeframe
note: Intraday longs who bought above average volume-weighted price are underwater after a loss of VWAP while higher timeframe momentum is weak, so their exits add supply.

name: failed rally above yesterday's high
note: Breakout buyers over the 24-bar high are trapped when price rejects back below yesterday's high; their stops fuel the decline.

name: MACD histogram roll in a range
note: In a range, upside momentum fades after tests of the upper half; buyers who bought the push are left holding and have no trend to bail them out.

name: 4h low break on volume short
note: Positions held above the prior 4h low are stopped out on a volume break, and trend followers then add to the downside.

name: directional shift off lows in quiet market
note: Shorts that sold into a quiet market have thin follow-through; when buyers begin to dominate they cover into low liquidity, with price below the EMA giving room to revert.

name: Keltner upper band rejection
note: Buyers who paid for a push outside the volatility channel are trapped when price falls back inside it, and without trend strength nothing sustains the move.

name: stochastic exit from overbought above VWAP
note: Range-bound buyers stretched above average traded price meet sellers when momentum rolls over, and nobody is forced to support price.

name: bullish fair value gap retest long
note: Unfilled bids left in an impulsive gap act as resting demand; shorts who sold the retest of the gap get trapped when it holds and must cover.

name: Failed sweep high short
note: Breakout buyers who bought the liquidity sweep above the n-bar high are trapped once price falls back below the EMA; their stops and forced liquidation feed the downside.

name: Bearish engulf below HTF high
note: A bearish engulfing at elevated RSI that is capped under the prior 4h high shows buyers absorbed and failed; chasers who bought the push have no exit but selling lower.

name: Bear divergence below EMA50
note: Higher high with weaker momentum below the medium EMA means buyers are exhausted inside a downtrend; late longs sit with stops just above the pivot.

name: HTF overbought stoch roll short
note: Position-limited momentum buyers on the 4h are overbought; when the fast oscillator rolls over from the extreme, marginal buyers vanish and profit-taking longs hit thin bids.

name: WaveTrend overbought cross short
note: Overbought WaveTrend rollover marks where late momentum longs hold the largest unrealized gain and are quickest to take it, leaving no fresh buyers.

name: Below Ichimoku cloud short
note: Price under the cloud with tenkan below kijun means holders from the prior range are all underwater and sell rallies to breakeven, a supply zone that caps bounces.

name: WaveTrend oversold cross long
note: Late shorts who sold into an oversold flush face squeeze risk when momentum turns in a non-trending market; they must cover to cap losses.

name: Extreme Bollinger stretch fade
note: In a non-trending regime a 2.5 sigma stretch is mostly illiquid chasing; buyers paying the extreme have no follow-through and revert to the mean.

name: Downtrend pullback resumption short
note: Bounce buyers in a higher-timeframe downtrend fail at the midline; when RSI crosses back under 50 their counter-trend longs are underwater and exit.

name: Bearish FVG rejection short
note: Price re-entering a bearish gap and closing back below its base shows unfilled sell orders resting there; bounce buyers are absorbed by the original sellers.

name: Sweep low rejection long
note: A low sweep that closes back with a strong green body means breakdown sellers got trapped; their buy-to-cover stops fuel the reversal while price is still weak.

name: TMO zero cross below VWAP short
note: Net bar-direction count turning negative while price sits under VWAP means the session's volume-weighted buyers are in loss and the order flow is net sell.

name: HTF oversold stoch turn long
note: Forced sellers on the 4h are exhausted at oversold extremes and fast momentum turning up shows sellers lifting offers; shorts holding thin profit are squeezed in a non-trend regime.

name: failed breakout short
note: Breakout buyers and stop-loss orders above the n-bar high are triggered by the sweep, then price closes back under the EMA. Those longs are trapped and must sell into the reversal, and the stop cascade feeds it.

name: overextended range fade short
note: Late chasers buy an overextended spike in a non-trending market. With no trend to support the price, liquidity providers hold inventory they sold into the spike and mean reversion pays them.

name: prev-day-high rejection short
note: Breakout buyers above yesterday's high are rejected by a bearish engulfing bar. They hold losing longs with stops just beneath the bar, so their exits add to the selling.

name: 4h low break short
note: Longs sitting under the prior 4h low are stopped on a volume break. Their forced selling meets thin bids because the market was quiet before the break.

name: downtrend supertrend flip short
note: The flip down happens inside a higher-timeframe downtrend. Dip buyers and trailing-stop longs are on the wrong side and exit as the trailing level breaks.

name: htf overbought roll-over short
note: On the 4h chart the market is stretched. Short-term longs who bought late are left holding as the fast stochastic rolls over and momentum chasers have nothing to sell into.

name: CCI extreme recovery long
note: A washout with no trend behind it forces liquidations. When the extreme reading recovers, forced sellers are done and the shorts who pressed late must cover.

name: exhausted green run fade short
note: Six or more green Heikin Ashi candles with RSI above 70 means late momentum buyers are crowded in. Profit-takers and mean-reversion sellers outnumber the remaining buyers.

name: htf oversold bounce long
note: On the 4h chart the market is deeply oversold. Late sellers who shorted the extension are exposed when the short-term stochastic turns up and must cover into thin offers.

name: sub-VWAP momentum loss short
note: Buyers above the volume-weighted average cost are under water below VWAP. RSI losing 50 shows the bounce failed, so those holders sell to cut losses.

name: capitulation volume bounce long
note: High volume below the lower band is forced liquidation and stop-outs. When selling pressure fades, sellers have no more inventory to dump and shorts who sold the flush cover.

name: short prev-day-low break
note: Stop-loss orders of longs sit under yesterday's low; once breached on volume they become forced market sells, feeding continuation. Longs who bought the range cannot avoid exiting at their stops.

name: failed breakout short
note: Breakout buyers entered above the 20-bar high and the sweep failed; price back under EMA20 traps them underwater, and their stops plus liquidated momentum longs add supply.

name: failed breakdown long
note: Breakdown sellers shorted under the 20-bar low; the sweep failed and price reclaimed EMA20, so their covering buys and trapped stops fuel the squeeze.

name: range upper band fade short
note: In low-ADX regimes spikes above the band are liquidity-driven chasers with no trend backing; they have no fundamental reason to hold and mean-revert as liquidity returns.

name: downtrend rally short
note: In a downtrend defined on 4h, a bounce to RSI>55 draws bottom-pickers and short-coverers who are trapped when the trend resumes; they cannot avoid losses once the trend line holds.

name: bearish engulf at upper band
note: A bearish engulfing at the upper band on volume shows late buyers absorbed by supply; those who bought the extension are underwater and become sellers on any retrace.

name: range lower band reclaim long
note: Panic sellers in a non-trending market push price through the lower band; once WPR recovers, forced liquidations are exhausted and mean reversion has room.

name: kijun loss under cloud short
note: Price below the cloud losing the base line means dip buyers defending Kijun are failing; their stops cluster there and fire as sell orders.

name: overbought htf momentum roll short
note: When 4h RSI is stretched and the intraday RSI rolls over, late momentum buyers face fading follow-through and exit into one another; weak hands have no bid beneath.

name: oversold htf momentum roll long
note: After 4h RSI washout, forced sellers are done and intraday RSI turning up shows shorts taking profit; trapped late shorts must cover into thin offers.

name: day-high exhaustion short
note: A new day high on an indecisive candle with high RSI shows buyers losing aggression; breakout chasers placed stops tightly and are forced out on the first rejection.

name: day-low exhaustion long
note: A new day low on an indecisive candle with low RSI shows sellers losing aggression; breakdown shorts have tight stops and are squeezed on rejection.

name: below vwap momentum loss short
note: Participants who bought above the rolling VWAP are at a loss once price is below it; momentum rolling over turns them into sellers at breakeven, adding supply.

name: below vwap reversion long
note: Sellers who shorted below rolling VWAP face stretched deviation; when momentum turns, their cover orders plus buyers anchoring to VWAP lift price back toward it.

name: squeeze release down short
note: Volatility compression builds resting stops on both sides; the release bar with a bearish body triggers sell stops of range longs, which cannot cancel in time.

name: squeeze release up long
note: Compression builds buy stops from range shorts; a bullish release bar triggers those stops as forced buys that fuel the move.

name: bearish divergence short
note: A higher high with weaker RSI shows buyers fewer and later; those who bought the final push hold the top and sell on the first reversal.

name: inside bar break down short
note: An inside bar marks compression where range longs place stops just under the low; a downside break below EMA50 triggers them as market sells.

name: Asia range break long
note: Asia range shorts keep buy stops above the high; a London-hour break on volume above the 4h open triggers them as forced covering in thin early liquidity.

name: failed high sweep short
note: Breakout buyers and stop-buyers entered above the 20-bar high; when price closes back below the EMA the sweep is a trap and they must exit into falling price, feeding the move down.

name: engulfing rejection at upper channel
note: Buyers who bought the extension are trapped by a full-body bearish engulfing bar at the upper channel; their stops sit just above and their exits add selling pressure.

name: bearish divergence below EMA short
note: A higher high on weaker momentum means the marginal buyer is exhausted; longs holding the new high get no follow-through and unwind once price loses the EMA.

name: Asia range breakdown short
note: Asia-session range lows hold resting long stops and fade-buyers; a volume-backed break triggers those stops and range traders must cover, so the move extends when the range was quiet.

name: downtrend pullback resumption short
note: Dip-buyers who bought the bounce inside a Supertrend downtrend are caught when RSI rolls back under 45; they cannot exit except by selling into the resuming move.

name: WaveTrend overbought turn short
note: Momentum buyers entering at extreme oscillator readings have no fresh buyers behind them; the cross lower marks where the crowd turns net seller.

name: WaveTrend oversold turn long
note: Panic sellers at oversold extremes in a range have already sold; once sell pressure dries up shorts covering and value buyers push price back toward the mean.

name: inside bar break down with bearish DI
note: Compression bars hold two-sided resting orders; with sellers dominant, the downside break triggers the longs' stops and the coiled range releases in the direction of the stronger side.

name: falling KAMA retest short
note: An adaptive average that is falling means efficient downward drift; buyers of retests up to the midline get rejected and their exits add to supply.

name: StochRSI exhaustion fade short
note: With ADX low, extension above the 50 EMA is a liquidity excursion rather than trend; late buyers exit as StochRSI rolls, and reversion to the mean follows.

name: TMO flip below VWAP short
note: When the count of up-closes turns net negative and price is under rolling VWAP, the average participant is underwater and sells rallies to escape.

name: extreme lower band reversion long
note: Forced sellers hitting stops at a 2.5-sigma stretch in a trendless market exhaust supply quickly; there is no trend pulling price further and value buyers absorb the flush.

name: overbought bear engulf short
note: Late momentum buyers entered an extended push; a bearish engulfing bar shows supply absorbing all of the prior bar, leaving late longs underwater with stops just below.

name: bearish divergence short
note: A higher high on weaker momentum means breakout buyers are thinning; those who bought the new high have no follow-through and exit into a market with few bids.

name: Asia range breakdown short
note: Liquidity pooled under the quiet Asia range is triggered at London/NY participation; longs positioned for range mean reversion are stopped out and add to the downside move.

name: prev day low break short
note: Stops of dip buyers rest below yesterday's low; when it breaks on volume they become forced sellers, and fresh breakout shorts join.

name: supertrend flip down under htf EMA
note: Trailing-stop longs get flushed when the trend line flips, and the 4h trend is already down so there is no dip-buying support to absorb their selling.

name: failed rally short in htf downtrend
note: Counter-trend buyers bounced into the falling EMA; when RSI fails at 50 they are trapped, while higher-timeframe sellers use the bounce to add.

name: low sweep reclaim long
note: Breakdown sellers and stop-runs hit the 30-bar low and were rejected; the shorts that sold the break are trapped and must cover as price reclaims.

name: squeeze release down
note: Range traders sold-high/bought-low inside a compressing range; the release resolves with price below value so range longs are stopped and expansion follows downward.

name: htf oversold bounce long
note: Panic sellers on the 4h have exhausted supply and short-covering begins when the fast RSI turns up; those short late have little room left.

name: htf overbought rollover short
note: Late buyers pushed the 4h overbought; when the fast RSI rolls over, FOMO longs without support hold losses and unwind.

name: below vwap EMA break short
note: Participants who bought above the volume-weighted average cost are underwater and sell the first rally attempt; a loss of the EMA triggers their stops.

name: upper band rejection short
note: Breakout buyers at the band pay the spread to chase a non-trending move; rejection back inside traps them while range sellers lean on supply.

name: lower band rejection long
note: Breakdown sellers shorted a stretched 2.5-sigma move in a non-trending market; a close back inside leaves them trapped with weak follow-through.

name: day high sweep rejection short
note: Buy stops above the day high get triggered and then no one is left to buy; the breakout buyers are trapped as the bar closes bearish.

name: DI cross down with volume short
note: Directional shift on above-average volume shows sellers taking control; longs from the prior leg are stuck and trend followers add shorts.

name: TMO exhaustion turn long
note: After a run of down closes in a non-trending market, sellers are exhausted; shorts that sold late face a turn with no continuation and cover.

name: TMO exhaustion turn short
note: A string of up closes in a non-trending market draws in late buyers; when momentum turns they hold at the top with no follow-through and sell.

name: short prev-day-low break
note: Longs holding yesterday's low as support have stops just below it; the break on heavy volume triggers those stops and late buyers get trapped, feeding continued selling.

name: overextended range top fade
note: In a non-trending regime, momentum chasers buying a stretched move have no trend to sustain them; liquidity providers fade it and the chasers are the exit liquidity.

name: bearish divergence short
note: A higher high on weaker momentum means marginal buyers are absent; late longs holding the new high are underwater when it fails and sell into thin bids.

name: supertrend flip short in downtrend
note: Trend-followers and trailing-stop holders long in a downtrend must exit on the flip; their forced selling extends the leg while trend strength persists.

name: 4h low break short
note: Longs using the prior 4h bar's low as protective stop are forced out when it breaks on volume, creating a cascade of market sells.

name: downtrend bounce exhaustion short
note: Counter-trend bounce buyers in a downtrend are short-term and weak-handed; when the bounce stalls they exit, and trend sellers re-enter at better prices.

name: CCI exit from extreme short
note: Buyers at stretched premium to volume-weighted price are above average cost of the day's participants; when momentum fades, mean-reversion flows and profit-taking dominate.

name: WaveTrend oversold turn long
note: Forced and panic sellers at stretched lows are exhausted in non-trending conditions; liquidity providers buy the washout and shorts cover into the turn.

name: Ichimoku bearish below cloud
note: Cloud-based position holders have stops above the cloud; a bearish cross while below it confirms failure, and those longs are forced to liquidate.

name: extended green run fade
note: A long streak of green candles pulls in late momentum buyers just as marginal demand runs out; they are the liquidity for faders and snap-back sellers.

name: Keltner re-entry short
note: A close back inside the upper channel after an excursion shows the breakout failed; breakout buyers are trapped above value and sell into any weakness.

name: inside bar break down
note: Inside bars compress range and stack stops on both sides; the downside break triggers sell stops of longs and brings breakout shorts in a low-ADX regime ready to expand.

name: volume spike up fade
note: A sudden volume spike up is often a stop-run or news overshoot; those buying the spike pay a temporary liquidity premium and give it back as the impulse is absorbed.

name: volume spike down fade long
note: A high-volume downside spike usually reflects forced liquidations and stop cascades; once forced sellers are done, price reverts as liquidity returns.

name: sweep high fail short
note: Breakout buyers and stop-buyers enter above the 20-bar high; when the sweep fails and price closes back down they are trapped and their exits and stops feed the downside.

name: BB upper rejection short
note: In non-trending conditions, late chasers buying the band extension get rejected by the close back inside; they hold losing longs and must sell into the reversion.

name: bear engulf at upper band
note: Longs that bought the extended move see a full-body reversal bar; their stops cluster just above and a failed push traps them.

name: StochRSI overbought exit short
note: In ranging conditions the upper end of the range lacks fresh buyers; those who bought overbought readings are the exit liquidity.

name: kijun break short
note: Many participants use the base line as a trend-hold line; losing it triggers their exits and fresh shorts.

name: MACD roll below VWAP short
note: Price trading below volume-weighted average means recent buyers are underwater; a momentum roll makes them sellers on any bounce.

name: inside bar break down
note: A compressed inside bar leaves stops resting on both sides; the downside break forces trapped longs to exit and triggers breakout sellers.

name: TMO momentum flip short
note: Net bar-direction pressure turning negative means sellers now dominate candle by candle; longs holding hope get squeezed out as trend strength persists.

name: CCI overbought fade
note: Price extended above rolling VWAP is where buyers are most in profit; CCI rolling off 100 shows buying exhausted and profit-takers become sellers.

name: failed breakdown long
note: Shorts that entered on the breakdown are trapped when price takes out the previous bar's high; their covering and stops add to the rebound.

name: upper band rejection short
note: Late chasers buying the band spike in a range are left holding when price closes back inside; liquidity was exhausted at the extreme.

name: failed prev-day-high break short
note: Breakout longs above yesterday's high get engulfed immediately; their stops sit just below and cascade as the failure confirms.

name: supertrend flip down short
note: Trend-followers and trailing-stop holders are forced to exit longs on the flip; the directional DI confirmation shows sellers already dominate.

name: bearish divergence short
note: A higher high with weaker momentum means the marginal buyer has vanished; late longs have no one to sell to.

name: prev day low break short
note: Dip buyers defending yesterday's low are stopped out; breakout sellers add on volume so selling feeds on itself.

name: ichimoku below cloud short
note: Price below the cloud with tenkan under kijun means recent buyers are underwater; each bounce fails at their break-even sell orders.

name: stop run reversal long
note: A sweep below the 20-bar low harvests stop orders; once forced sellers are done, the engulfing bar shows the absorbing buyer and price reverts.

name: high volume bear bar short
note: A large-volume bearish bar out of a quiet market reveals informed or forced selling; passive bids behind it are thin and follow-through is common.

name: HA reversal below vwap long
note: Sellers pushed price below the rolling VWAP and are underwater on any bounce; consecutive green HA candles show their selling has dried up.

name: keltner upper re-entry short
note: Breakout buyers above the Keltner band in a low-trend market are trapped when price closes back inside; their stops sit below.

name: macd rollover from strength short
note: Momentum longs who bought strength see MACD roll over from elevated RSI; the lack of new buyers pushes them to exit in a clump.

name: failed sweep high bear engulf
note: Breakout buyers and stop-hunted longs are trapped above the swept high; when price closes back inside with an engulfing bar they must sell into weakness to cut losses, feeding the move down.

name: RSI exhaustion roll-over short
note: Late momentum buyers entered at stretched levels in a non-trending market; once RSI rolls over they have no trend to rescue them and must exit to a thin bid.

name: prev day low break short
note: Longs defending yesterday's low place stops just beneath it; a high-volume break forces those stops to execute as market sells, adding to downward pressure.

name: StochRSI fade below VWAP
note: Buyers who bought a bounce still below volume-weighted average cost are underwater on average; as the bounce exhausts they sell at breakeven, capping rallies.

name: supertrend flip down with RSI still high
note: Trailing-stop longs get force-exited at the flip while RSI shows holders still positioned long; their liquidation is mechanical selling with more room to run.

name: Keltner stretch reversal candle
note: Panic sellers and forced liquidations pushed price an extreme ATR multiple from the mean; a strong green body signals the forced flow has ended and shorts must cover.

name: sweep low reclaim
note: Breakout shorts entering on the low sweep are trapped when price immediately reclaims with a strong body; their stops above fuel the squeeze.

name: CCI deep oversold recovery
note: Leveraged sellers who pushed price to a deep deviation get margin-called or stopped; the cross back marks the end of forced selling in a non-trending tape.

name: 4h low breakdown on volume
note: Longs holding under the prior 4h low have stops clustered there; a volume surge through it triggers stop-market sells and sellers pile in.

name: KAMA loss after strong RSI
note: Dip-buyers who bought a bounce in a flat market see adaptive average lost while RSI is still elevated; they exit together, giving a quick leg down.

name: bear engulf at high RSI
note: A full bearish engulfing after a stretched rally shows buyers fully absorbed by sellers; recent buyers sit underwater at the bar's top and exit into declining bids.

name: bear_engulf_above_pdh
note: Prior-day-high breakout buyers get engulfed on the same bar. They are underwater immediately and their protective stops sit just below the bar, so their exit adds to the selling.

name: st_flip_down_htf
note: Trailing-stop longs are forced out when the supertrend flips, and they sit below a falling 4h trend where dip-buyers keep getting hit. Short only fires when the higher timeframe is already bearish.

name: upper_band_exhaust
note: In a low-ADX range, a spike beyond 2.5 sigma that then rolls over catches chasing momentum buyers at the extreme. The inventory they hold has to be unwound back toward the mean.

name: pdl_break_volume
note: Prior-day-low is where day-traders put long stops. A volume-backed break runs those stops and the resulting market sell orders extend the move.

name: htf_overbought_roll
note: Overbought on the 4h chart means positioning is stretched long. When the 1h RSI rolls over, profit-taking from stretched longs finds few fresh buyers.

name: ha_exhaustion
note: Four-plus green Heikin Ashi candles with RSI above 70 means buyers have chased an extended move with little pullback. They have no cushion and are the supply when momentum fades.

name: macd_down_below_vwap
note: Price below the rolling VWAP means the average participant is underwater. A downward momentum cross there brings stop-loss selling from those holders, with no one defending their cost.

name: pivot_low_range_buy
note: In a no-trend market a confirmed pivot low below VWAP is where aggressive sellers have run out of follow-through. Shorts who sold the low must cover as price reverts toward fair value.

name: pivot_high_range_sell
note: In a non-trending market a confirmed pivot high above VWAP marks where buyers ran out of follow-through. Longs bought the top and must sell as price reverts to fair value.

name: impulse_bear_volume
note: A large bearish bar on heavy volume under the EMA50 means institutional selling that cannot be completed in one bar. The remainder is worked out over the following hours, and trapped longs add to it.

name: quiet_range_breakdown
note: A break below a low-ADX 20-bar range triggers stops from range-bound longs and breakout sellers. Volume confirms it is real, and volatility expansion following a quiet period gives room to run.

name: day_low_break_volume
note: Intraday longs place stops under the session low. A volume break below it forces market sells into a market whose bids are thin, and the cascade carries price further.

name: Asia range breakdown short
note: Breakdown from a quiet overnight range: stop-loss orders of range buyers and late longs sit just below the low and are forced market sells, adding to the move on rising volume.

name: Bearish divergence above VWAP short
note: A higher high on weaker momentum means new buying is thinning; late longs sit above VWAP with the average trader underwater on any reversal and must sell to cut risk.

name: Supertrend flip short with weak 4h
note: Trend-following funds and trailing-stop longs are forced out when the ATR trail breaks; with the 4h RSI already below 50 there are few buyers to absorb that forced selling.

name: Prev day low break short
note: Longs who bought the prior day's low as support have stops just under it; a high volume break forces those stops to market and attracts momentum sellers.

name: Overbought 4h rollover short
note: After an extended 4h run, buyers are crowded and positioned; when short-term momentum rolls over, profit takers and late buyers' stops hit a thin bid side.

name: Range top exhaustion short
note: In a ranging market, price stretched above rolling VWAP has no trend support; liquidity providers who sold the stretch are inventory-heavy and revert price to the average.

name: CCI exhaustion roll short
note: CCI falling back under 100 marks the end of a stretched push in a range; chasers who bought the extension get no follow-through and exit as price reverts toward VWAP.

name: StochRSI turn below lower band long
note: Panic sellers and stopped-out longs in a range have pushed price beyond the lower band; once downside momentum turns, there are no more forced sellers and price reverts.

name: WaveTrend oversold cross long
note: A WaveTrend cross up from deep oversold means selling pressure is exhausted; late shorts who sold the low face a snap-back and must buy to cover into thin offers.

name: Heikin Ashi streak break short
note: After five or more green HA candles the crowd is long and late; the first red candle shows buyers stopped, and trailing stops of momentum longs begin to trigger.

name: NY open range break down short
note: The first two hours of US session set the initial balance; break-outs below it on elevated volume trigger stops from open-range buyers and attract institutional flow that has to be executed across the session.

name: Keltner upper re-entry short
note: Price re-entering the channel from above shows the outside-channel push was an overshoot driven by market orders; those buyers hold losing positions and the regime lacks trend to keep price out.

name: Stop run below prev low long
note: Sell stops under yesterday's low are harvested, then supply dries up and price closes back above; breakdown sellers are trapped short and have to cover in a non-trending market.

name: downtrend rsi relapse short
note: Dip buyers who bought the bounce inside a supertrend downtrend get trapped when RSI rolls back under 45. They hold losing longs with stops beyond the flip line, and their exits add selling pressure.

name: sweep high engulf short
note: A stop run above the 20-bar high fills breakout longs, then a bearish engulfing bar shows the sweep had no follow-through. Those longs are trapped and must sell into the reversal.

name: bear divergence under ema short
note: A higher high on weaker RSI means buyers are spending momentum on each push, and the price slipping under the EMA20 confirms that supply has taken over. Late longs holding above the prior pivot are trapped.

name: htf overbought roll short
note: Four-hour RSI is stretched, so many longs are sitting on extended gains. When the 1h price loses its EMA20 they take profit together, and late buyers become trapped holders.

name: quiet range breakdown short
note: After low-ADX compression, range-bound longs have stops just under the 20-bar low. Breaking it triggers those stops and attracts breakout sellers, so the move extends while the market is quiet.

name: bull divergence below vwap long
note: A lower low on higher RSI shows sellers are running out of force while price is stretched below its volume-weighted average. Late shorts are offside, and their covering plus reversion toward VWAP provides the fuel.

name: ha run exhaustion short
note: Five green Heikin Ashi candles with RSI above 70 in a weak-trend market means momentum chasers have already bought. No fresh buyers remain, and the profit-taking by those chasers sets the downside.

name: kijun reclaim long
note: Shorts positioned under the Kijun in a low-ADX range have stops just above it. A reclaim that also clears the cloud span triggers them to cover, while breakout buyers join.

name: bear fvg retest short
note: Bounce buyers retest an unfilled bearish gap from below, where earlier sellers left resting orders. Failing there leaves those buyers underwater, and the supply defending the gap is still intact.

name: gold sell flow burst short
note: An unusual burst of sell-side flow below the EMA50 is informed or forced selling, such as stops and liquidation. Passive bids are overrun, and the book needs time to rebuild, so the move continues.

name: inside bar below vwap short
note: An inside bar under VWAP shows buyers failing to lift price, so the coil is likely to resolve down. Longs who bought the compression have stops under the bar's low, and sellers join on the break.

name: range upper band fade
note: In non-trending markets, late breakout buyers chase an overextended push to the upper band; with no trend follow-through they are stranded and liquidate back to the mean.

name: sweep high rejection
note: Breakout buyers and stop-buy orders above the recent high are triggered, then the bearish engulfing shows no absorption; trapped longs must sell into the reversal.

name: HTF overbought pullback start
note: Higher-timeframe overbought readings attract profit-taking; the lower-timeframe RSI rolling over shows the first sellers and late buyers become exit liquidity.

name: Asia range breakdown
note: Overnight range longs and resting stops sit under the Asia low; a volume-backed break triggers those stops and the forced selling extends the move.

name: oversold engulfing bounce
note: Panic sellers and stop-outs exhaust at an oversold low; the engulfing bar shows absorption and shorts must cover into rising bids.

name: StochRSI lower band recovery
note: Late shorts selling below the lower band in a non-trending market get caught when momentum turns; their cover buys feed the snap back.

name: bull divergence below VWAP
note: A lower low on stronger RSI means sellers are drying up; shorts who sold the low sit on thin profit and cover back toward VWAP.

name: extreme Williams %R exit below Keltner
note: Price stretched below the volatility envelope forces margin and stop selling; when selling exhausts, remaining shorts become buyers on the rebound.

name: failed rally under EMA100
note: Dip-sellers' bounce stalled below the average: bounce buyers who entered into resistance see RSI lose 50 and must exit, adding supply.

name: Kijun loss short
note: The base line is the midpoint of a 26-bar range; losing it in a quiet market signals buyers have given up the range midpoint and longs below breakeven exit.

name: sweep high failure
note: Breakout buyers and stop-loss orders above the recent high get filled, then price rejects with a bearish engulfing bar. Those late longs are trapped and must sell into the reversal as it moves against them.

name: RSI exhaustion roll
note: In a non-trending market an overbought reading that rolls over marks buyers running out of follow-through. Momentum chasers who bought the push sit at a loss and exit into thin bids.

name: upper band rejection
note: A wick through the 2.5 sigma band that closes back inside shows a stretched move that failed to hold. Breakout buyers at the extreme get trapped in a ranging market and sell as price returns to the mean.

name: supertrend flip down
note: A trailing-stop flip with real directional strength forces trend-follower longs to exit via their stops. Their forced selling feeds the move, and a downtrend can run without any need for the market to rise.

name: Asia range breakdown
note: Overnight range traders have stops just beyond the Asia low. When London or New York volume breaks it, the stops and breakout sellers pile in, and the quiet-range energy releases into a directional leg.

name: MACD cross below long MA
note: In an established downtrend, rallies that fade create a momentum cross-down just as dip buyers give up. They are forced to cut losses into a market that still has sellers above.

name: capitulation spike down
note: A violent drop on double volume is forced selling from margin calls and stop cascades, not informed selling. When the forced sellers are done, price rebounds because nobody is left pushing it lower.

name: 4h low break
note: A break of the prior 4h low below the 4h EMA triggers stops of intraday dip buyers and position traders. Their forced exits meet fewer bids on a lower-timeframe downtrend.

name: kijun cross below cloud
note: Price below the cloud failing at the base line means rally buyers are stuck below resistance. Ichimoku followers and trapped longs sell as the base line is lost again.

name: DI cross down
note: Directional pressure passing to sellers while trend strength is present and price is under its mean. Dip buyers who averaged in are forced out as selling dominates.

name: heikin ashi exhaustion
note: Four or more consecutive green candles with RSI above 70 shows a crowded move. Late buyers have no one left to sell to, and profit-takers exit into a thinning bid.

name: CCI washout rebound
note: A deep CCI washout on elevated volume is forced liquidation. As the sellers who needed to exit finish, price snaps back to the mean.

name: bearish divergence in strength
note: A higher price high on lower RSI means the extension is carried by fewer buyers. Breakout buyers holding at the top are exposed when buying power fades.

name: keltner stretch fade
note: Price stretched 2.5 ATR above its mean with overbought RSI in a market without strong trend is a liquidity-driven overshoot. Chasers get no follow-through and mean reversion pulls price back.

name: lower band rejection
note: A wick through the lower band that closes back inside with a bullish engulfing bar shows breakdown sellers trapped. Their stops and covering fuel a reversal toward the mean.

name: failed prev-day-high break short
note: Breakout buyers and stop-buy orders above yesterday's high get trapped when price closes back under it. They must sell to exit, and their stop selling adds to downside pressure.

name: sweep high plus bear engulf
note: Stops above the 20-bar high get harvested, then a bearish engulfing bar shows the breakout longs are trapped. Their forced exits feed the move down.

name: bearish divergence short
note: A higher high on weaker momentum means late buyers are chasing with fading follow-through. Whoever bought the last high is underwater with no fresh demand behind them.

name: HTF downtrend pullback sell
note: Counter-trend dip buyers in a 4h downtrend are sitting on losses as the rally fades. Their stops, plus trend sellers re-entering, push price down. Short side, so it does not depend on a rising market.

name: Asia range breakdown at London
note: Asia-session range traders have stops clustered below the range low. London liquidity breaks it and triggers stops, with volume confirming real flow rather than a drift.

name: 3-sigma capitulation long
note: Moves beyond 3 sigma are mostly forced liquidation, such as margin calls and stop cascades. Once the forced sellers are done, price snaps back toward the mean. The wide target is paid for by the rarity of the setup.

name: Keltner rejection short
note: Price that stretched above the Keltner band and then loses top-of-range momentum shows buyers failing at the extreme. Those who bought the extension have no exit liquidity above.

name: momentum roll-over short
note: In a range, momentum rolling over from the upper half of RSI means the push is exhausted. Late longs hold losses as price rotates back down to range mid and low.

name: HTF overbought roll-over
note: The 4h chart is stretched, so trapped late longs and profit-takers need exits. A drop in the 1h RSI signals the start of the unwind while there is still room.

name: HTF oversold turn long
note: After a 4h oversold extreme, shorts that sold the lows are sitting on profit with little room left. Their cover orders plus the first bid recovery produce a bounce back to the mean.

name: high-volume bear engulf above VWAP
note: A high-volume rejection above VWAP shows that supply absorbed the buyers who chased. Those buyers are above value and underwater, and they sell on a move back to VWAP.

name: Ichimoku base-line break down
note: A break under the base line and below the cloud flips the many Ichimoku followers to defensive. Longs sell out and shorts add in a coordinated way.

name: confirmed overbought pivot high short
note: A confirmed pivot high on stretched RSI marks where buyers failed and price rolled over. Buyers near the top are underwater and sell into any retest.

name: London range break up on volume
note: Range sellers have buy-stops above the London range high, and volume confirms the break is real flow. Their covering feeds the move from quiet ranges, with room to run in FX.

name: prev-day-low sweep reclaim long
note: A sweep of yesterday's low that closes back above it traps breakdown shorts. They must buy to cover, and the stops of those who sold the break fuel the reclaim.

name: short failed rally in downtrend
note: Dip-buyers who bought the bounce into falling EMA100 are trapped when RSI rolls over; their stops and capitulation add supply.

name: range upper band rejection
note: Late chasers buying a stretched spike in a non-trending market are left holding when the rejection closes back inside the band.

name: kijun break below cloud
note: Cloud-based longs have their protective level at kijun; losing it below the cloud forces exits with no support left.

name: Asia range breakdown
note: Overnight range traders have stops below the range low; London-hours volume breaks trigger them and range-fade buyers get squeezed out.

name: bearish RSI divergence
note: Higher highs with weakening momentum mean marginal buyers are exhausted; late longs have no one to sell to.

name: stoch exit overbought above vwap
note: Participants who bought above the rolling VWAP are at a loss when momentum rolls over in a range; they sell back toward average cost.

name: macd rollover under ema200
note: Counter-trend bounce buyers in a bear regime are caught as momentum fades before RSI reaches oversold, so there is room left to fall.

name: keltner breakdown strong trend
note: In a strong downtrend, a close outside the Keltner channel forces margin-called longs and breakout sellers to act together.

name: failed Asia range breakdown
note: Breakdown sellers who shorted the false break are trapped; their buy-to-cover orders push price back through the range.

name: wavetrend oversold cross
note: Panic sellers in a non-trending market have exhausted supply at oversold extremes; shorts must buy back as momentum turns.

name: fade spike up with red bar
note: Stop-run and news spikes in a non-trending market attract late chasers; a red close shows buying was one-off and the chasers are trapped.

name: bear engulf below vwap trend
note: Buyers defending the average price are overwhelmed by an engulfing bar below VWAP, and their stops trigger as ADX confirms directional flow.

name: Short rally spike below EMA100
note: Counter-trend buyers chase a short spike inside a downtrend and get trapped; their stops and the trend's sellers push price back down.

name: BB upper exhaustion fade low ADX
note: In non-trending conditions, breakout chasers buy extremes with no follow-through; they become trapped longs who must sell back into the range.

name: MACD hist roll-over from elevated RSI
note: Late momentum buyers at elevated RSI face fading impulse; with no trend to sustain it, their positions get unwound as momentum rolls over.

name: Asia range break down on volume
note: Longs placed inside the Asia range have stops just below its low; a volume break triggers those stops and fuels follow-through at session open.

name: Prev-day low break with volume
note: Buyers defending yesterday's low have stops below it; a high-volume break forces them out and attracts momentum shorts.

name: WaveTrend oversold cross up in range
note: Panic sellers at range lows are exhausted; shorts covering and value buyers face no more supply, so price reverts toward range middle.

name: Heikin Ashi run exhaustion fade
note: A long streak of green candles draws in trend-chasers late; with weak ADX there is no trend, so these buyers become trapped and sell on the first stall.

name: Bull engulf at oversold discount
note: Capitulation sellers push price far under VWAP and then run out of supply; engulfing bar shows buyers absorbing and shorts must cover.

name: RSI cross down in falling EMA
note: Buyers of shallow bounces in a falling market get caught when RSI rolls over again; sellers re-enter on failed relief rallies.

name: 4h low sweep and reclaim
note: Breakdown sellers below the prior 4h low are trapped when price reclaims it; their stops, buy-to-cover orders, and stop hunters feed a move back up.

name: overextended range short
note: In low-ADX regimes, late chasers buying a 2.5-sigma spike have no trend support; liquidity providers fade the move and the buyers cannot exit without hitting bids.

name: Asia range failed break short
note: Breakout traders buying the Asia range high get trapped when the break is rejected; their stops and the mean-reverting range participants drive price back through the range.

name: HTF weak breakdown short
note: When the 4h trend is weak, a break of the 20-bar low triggers stops of dip buyers and prompts position unwinds; underwater longs sell into falling bids.

name: bearish divergence short
note: A higher high on weaker momentum means marginal buyers are exhausted; late longs sit on a thin cushion and have to sell when the bid fails.

name: stretched above VWAP rollover short
note: Price stretched above volume-weighted fair value in a non-trending market attracts value sellers; momentum buyers are forced out as the oscillator rolls over.

name: downtrend MACD short
note: In a downtrend, relief-rally buyers get squeezed out as momentum rolls over again; trapped counter-trend longs must sell below both trend filters.

name: London first-hour break long
note: Shorts positioned in the overnight lull and stops above the first London hour high are forced to cover when European volume enters and breaks the range.

name: London first-hour break short
note: Overnight longs and buy-side stops under the first London hour low are forced to sell when European volume breaks the range.

name: below cloud kijun short
note: Price below the cloud means trend-following longs are underwater; a kijun break triggers their systematic exits and new trend shorts.

name: HTF overbought rollover short
note: When the 4h is overbought, late trend buyers have no new demand behind them; the 1-bar momentum rollover triggers profit-taking and weak-hand stop-outs.

name: HTF oversold bounce long
note: After the 4h is oversold, forced sellers and late shorts are exhausted; short covering plus value buyers drive a bounce once momentum turns.

name: Keltner breakdown short
note: A close outside the lower Keltner in a downtrend forces trapped dip-buyers to stop out and trend funds to add, continuing the move.
